Sereum is a runtime protection mechanism for smart contracts on the Ethereum blockchain. Sereum targets re-entrancy attacks on smart contracts. Sereum monitors transaction execution at runtime.

Smart Contract Cover is a decentralized insurance protocol for smart contract failures. Smart Contract Cover is built on public blockchains such as Ethereum.

DeFiLlama is an analytics platform that tracks total value locked across DeFi protocols. DeFiLlama is an aggregator of data and does not custody user funds.

Ronin Bridge is a cross-chain bridge connecting the Ronin sidechain to Ethereum. Ronin Bridge relies on a set of validators that control asset custody. Ronin Bridge was exploited in March 2022, resulting in a large loss of funds.
